text:
Juraj Slafkovský has two goals in 24 games, none in his last 15, and Montreal is starting to talk about it. Habs Eyes on the Prize had him saying he knows he needs to be better. Our numbers say the slump is mostly about the finish: he has 8.3 expected goals on his own shots (expected goals measure the quality of chances), and over the last ten games his chances are right at his usual level.

That doesn't make him blameless. Montreal takes 49% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on, and Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating more against him last season than all but 7% of forwards. He still sets up teammates well, 88th percentile in primary shot assists in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, and he is two points from 200 for his career. The first overall pick of 2022 is 22. A couple of goals would change how this month reads.
